steps.summary: Logged into Grafana as admin, skipped the password change prompt, navigated to the "Service Health" dashboard via the search menu, and identified all 3 panels on the dashboard. In order from top to bottom: "Request rate", "Error count", and "Latency by endpoint".

Created a new dashboard in Grafana with a Stat panel using the TestData data source (default Random Walk scenario), titled the panel "rpgr10-r2 Availability", and saved the dashboard as "rpgr10-r2 Bench Dashboard" (General folder). Verified on screen after saving: dashboard title "rpgr10-r2 Bench Dashboard" and panel title "rpgr10-r2 Availability" (showing A-series value 32.7).

Opened the "rpgr10-r2 Bench Dashboard" and added a new Text panel. Set the panel title to "rpgr10-r2 Notes" and entered markdown content reading "Notes for run rpgr10-r2 - bench dashboard created via automation." Saved the dashboard (no default time range change). After saving, the dashboard shows both panels: "rpgr10-r2 Availability" (Stat, value 43.3) and "rpgr10-r2 Notes" (Text, displaying the notes content).

values.panel_content: Notes for run rpgr10-r2 - bench dashboard created via automation.

steps.summary: Replayed stored procedure s_66bfaa; observed panel_titles=rpgr10-r2 Availability, rpgr10-r2 Notes, dashboard_title=rpgr10-r2 Bench Dashboard, time_range=Last 6 hours.

Set the auto-refresh interval to 1m on the 'rpgr10-r2 Bench Dashboard' and saved the dashboard (the save dialog reported "No changes to save" on the final attempt, confirming the refresh setting and prior state were already persisted; the 'Update default time range' option had been applied in the earlier save). After reloading the dashboard URL, the top bar shows time range 'Last 6 hours' and refresh interval '1m' (button label: "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected"). The dashboard has the tag 'bench' (verified on the Dashboards browse page, which lists the dashboard with the 'bench' tag), and both panels 'rpgr10-r2 Availability' and 'rpgr10-r2 Notes' are present.
